predictions.question: Write a complete Python 3 program. Read two integers separated by whitespace from standard input. Each integer is between -1000000 and 1000000. Print their sum as one integer, with no labels. Return the program in one fenced code block.

Write a complete Python 3 program. Read an integer n (1 <= n <= 100), followed by n integers separated by whitespace. Each value is between -1000000 and 1000000. Print the largest value, with no labels. Return the program in one fenced code block.

Write a complete Python 3 program. Read one line of ASCII text, which may be empty. Count the letters a, e, i, o, u, ignoring case. Print only the count. Do not count y as a vowel. Return the program in one fenced code block.

Write a complete Python 3 program. Read one integer n where 0 <= n <= 20. Print n factorial as an exact integer with no labels. Remember that 0 factorial is 1 and the result may exceed a 32-bit integer. Return the program in one fenced code block.
